title: The breath as a homecoming
summary: Every inhale is an invitation to return. To your body. To this moment. To yourself.

blocks.text: Breath isn't just air—it is direction. Each inhale can guide you back to your senses. Each exhale can soften the grip of worry.
Breathe in for four, out for four. When your mind wanders, gently notice and count again. No fixing—just coming back.
